description:
The Open Source Alternative To Notion.

AppFlowy is an open source alternative to Notion.
You are in charge of your data and customizations.
### 🚀 v0.14.11

#### New Features

• **Relative-date comparisons** — Added Today, Yesterday, and Tomorrow to date comparisons such as before, after, on or before, and on or after, so filters followed the calendar without selecting a new date each day.
• **YouTube captions** — Added direct import of available timestamped captions into AI transcript blocks without downloading audio or using transcription minutes. Retained audio transcription and file upload as alternatives when captions were unavailable.
• **Missing row pages** — Added a "Create empty page" action when a supporting server reported an unavailable row document, with a warning and explicit confirmation. Kept readable and locally cached content ahead of recreation.

#### Improvements

• **Gallery views** — Added grouped card layouts, configurable previews and card sizes, image fitting, and cover repositioning.
• **Feed views** — Refreshed card previews, quick actions, reactions, and comment discussions, with a full-page action for longer content.
• **Plans and connections** — Routed hosted upgrade prompts through the Plan settings, kept Cloud billing unavailable in local and self-hosted sessions, and added clearer connection-loading errors with retry actions.

#### Bug Fixes

• Fixed linking databases with incomplete sync data, refreshing embedded database tabs after sync, and loading repaired rows after an explicit retry.
• Made formula properties easier to find in filter and sort pickers, paused incompatible filters when formula result types changed, and corrected rollups that read other rollups.
• Preserved center peek when navigating between rows and prevented canceled row-page opens from leaving later opens stuck.
• Corrected page-reference states for trashed, missing, and temporarily unavailable pages, and stopped slow permission lookups from holding up the Share menu's people list.
• Kept reconnect feedback visible until the connection was confirmed, with another retry available if it did not connect.

#### ⚠️ Action Required

• Self-hosted workspaces still require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.19.10 or later**. Before enabling missing-row-page recovery, deploy its server support to every node handling live edits.
